__COMMENT0__: This file is used to configure the supported locales for the ext. If you are here and want to add yours
__COMMENT2__: Go to your Language, click on it, and do CTRL + SHIFT + S to download the file, place it in this dir, and add the language name in the LOCALES
__COMMENT3__: This is to prevent the zip being bloated with languages that you won't use.
